d:
Three alleged criminals were killed in a police encounter in Sherpur village of Maner, near Patna, on November 6. According to the police, the three men were wanted in several criminal cases and had opened fire on a joint team of Patna Police and the STF. A police officer was also injured in the exchange of fire. But the controversy did not end there. Relatives of the deceased alleged that the encounter was fake, while MP Misa Bharti questioned the police action. What happened that morning, and why has the encounter triggered a political controversy in Bihar?
Production: Akash Singh
